description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scornful Egotist, adding {U}.
When Scornful Egotist dies, Yedora triggers, returning Scornful Egotist from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Scornful Egotist by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Scornful Egotist's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
